stories.summary: Reduced U.S. climate financing and financial strain tied to global conflicts have left fewer companies with spare cash to spend on carbon credits. PHOTO/ MICHAEL KAKUMIRIZI East Africa is excited about carbon credits now. Five years ago, a developer could set up a carbon project, get it checked by an outside auditor, and start selling credits without much trouble.
